div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EntityDescription_AssignClientMethodIds
@ ghidra://SGW.exe@0x01590df0
encode method index i

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute per-entity threshold:
nExposedCount = (ptr24 - ptr20) / 4
iVar2 = (nExposedCount + 0xC0) / 0xFF
idBase = 0x3E - iVar2

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Worked example — SGWPlayer
nExposedCount = 157
iVar2 = (157 + 0xC0) / 0xFF
= 0x10D / 0xFF = 1
idBase = 0x3E - 1 = 61

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Single-byte encoding
MethodDescription+0x44 = i
MethodDescription+0x48 = 0xFFFFFFFF
wire: [1 byte: i]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two-byte encoding
high = (i - idBase) >> 8
low = (i - idBase) & 0xFF
MethodDescription+0x44 = high + idBase
MethodDescription+0x48 = low
wire: [1 byte: high+idBase] [1 byte: low]

span.p:
SGWPlayer index 61 → first two-byte
= minigameCallDisplay
(MinigamePlayer.def, 10th ClientMethod entry,
zero-based offset 9 inside indices 52..64)
